instruction: Search for a one-way ticket from Brussels to Madrid for 2 adults and 1 child, with departure on the 5th day of next month.

metadata.explanation: Task variation 2: Search for one-way flight from Brussels Charleroi (CRL) to Madrid (MAD) for 2 adults and 1 child on 5th of next month. Uses existing evaluator functions to verify URL parameters including child passenger count. Similar complexity with additional passenger type selection.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts all URL parameters needed to verify the flight search (origin, destination, passenger counts, date, one-way flag)
Getter uses active_tab_url_parse to parse Ryanair URL query parameters, which is the correct approach for verifying search form submission
All instruction requirements are covered: Brussels (CRL) to Madrid (MAD), 2 adults, 1 child, 5th of next month, one-way flight
Expected values are semantically correct: CRL is the correct IATA code for Brussels Charleroi (Ryanair's hub), MAD for Madrid, passenger counts match instruction
Metric check_direct_json_object performs exact match comparison, which is appropriate for structured URL parameters
Relative time processing (get_rule_relativeTime) correctly handles '5th next month' calculation and formats it to match Ryanair's URL parameter format
The evaluator checks tpTeens: '0' even though not explicitly mentioned in instruction, which ensures complete passenger count verification
